text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an All-Way Stop Control not be installed at the intersection of Rouge River Drive and Bald Eagle Avenue as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has stop controls facing the northbound and southbound approaches on Bald Eagle Avenue at Rouge River Drive of this four-way intersection.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Rouge River Drive and Bald Eagle Avenue.
